# Steam account-page fixtures

Derived 2026-08-29 from two pages the repo owner saved from their own signed-in browser:
`store.steampowered.com/account/licenses/` and `store.steampowered.com/account/history/`.
The originals stay in the git-ignored `gdpr/` directory and are never committed. These
fixtures were generated by a transformation script, not hand-copied.

**Sanitized:** persona name and vanity URL replaced with a fake; account id, session id,
wallet balances, and every embedded JSON blob removed by stripping all `<script>` bodies;
all product titles replaced with invented names chosen to preserve the shapes that matter
to the parser (registered-trademark mark, spaced colons, long DLC suffix chains, an "Early
Access" suffix, an accented character, an ampersand, a numeric sequel); card issuer and
last-four fragments replaced with a neutral placeholder; transaction ids replaced with
zero-padded synthetic ids; package ids replaced with synthetic ones; gift recipient's
persona, community URL and miniprofile id replaced. The saved-page `_files` asset folders
were NOT copied; parser input is the HTML document only, so no CSS, images or scripts are
needed or present. Country/locale JSON was removed with the scripts.

**One locale sample.** All fixtures reflect a US-locale account. Dates render as
"MMM d, yyyy" and money as a "$"-prefixed value with "," grouping and "." decimals. The
parser declines dates it cannot read in that form rather than guessing, and counts them.

| File | Covers |
|---|---|
| `licenses-page1.html` | 13 licence rows plus one deliberately malformed row with no acquisition cell. Acquisition methods: "Steam Store", "Complimentary" (the only kind carrying a package id, via the `RemoveFreeLicense` remove-link), "Gift/Guest Pass", and one method the parser does not recognise ("Retail Purchase"). Carries the paginator ("Showing licenses 1-100 of 979") and the next-page link, so it is a truncated first page |
| `licenses-final-page.html` | A last page: same row shapes, paginator present, no next link |
| `purchase-history.html` | 12 transaction rows plus one malformed row with no date cell. Covers: discounted purchase, undiscounted purchase, gift purchase (with recipient block inside the items cell), a six-item bundle row under one price, in-game purchase (the only shape carrying an appid, in its help-wizard URL), wallet top-up, digital gift-card redemption (no type and no prices, wallet change only), two purchases marked refunded, a standalone Refund transaction, and a thousands-grouped amount. The load-more control is present and visible, so the document is a truncated first page |
| `purchase-history-exhausted.html` | The same table with the load-more control hidden via inline `display:none`, which is how Steam's own script expresses "nothing more to load" |
| `not-an-account-page.html` | Hand-written, not derived: a page from the same origin that is neither account page, so the parsers' "format not recognized" path has something to refuse |
